 "architecture": "One decision function per observation, written as a fixed priority cascade (no utility scoring except for target and loot choice), plus a table of about 15 behaviour switches that can be overridden per bot instance so two variants can be A/B tested in-process on a shared read-only map. Per-tick order: (1) answer any upgrade offer from a fixed ranked list (separate lists for practice and free-for-all); (2) read events: damage sets a threat bearing and a per-attacker timestamp, kills are counted; (3) update the practice-vs-free-for-all detector; (4) nearby non-\"far\" weapon/step/jet sounds set a threat bearing if nothing fresher than 1.5 s exists; (5) compute zone urgency; (6) choose a mech target by score, else a drone target; (7) set dodge timers from incoming projectiles and laser charge telegraphs; (8) aim and fire (mortar first, then gun plus secondary); (9) choose a loot goal and, if idle, a crate to shoot or a scan direction; (10) movement mode in strict order: zone urgent > fight > free-for-all hide > heal in cover > loot goal > roam; then three overrides applied on top in order: final-circle positioning, dodge, stuck escape; (11) execute movement through the path follower or local steering. Target score (lower wins) = distance in metres + HP/20 + 120 if not currently in line of sight, minus 25 for the current target, minus 20 if it is charging a laser, minus 40 if it hurt us in the last 4 s; mechs beyond 150 m are skipped unless they hurt us in the last 6 s.",
 "navigation": "Map model: a 1 m column grid built by rasterising every prism with point-in-polygon tests; each column stores terrain height, the top of any solid standing on the ground (prism base within 1.5 m of ground) and one overhang interval (lowest base, highest top) for bridges. Line of sight is a point sample roughly every metre against those columns (no trees, no canopy). Nav grid: 2 m cells, cell height = highest top among its four columns; an overhang with less than 9.5 m of headroom counts as a wall. A wall-proximity cost multiplier is added (plus 2.5 for cells touching something more than 1.2 m taller, plus 0.6 one cell further out). Edges: walk when the rise is at most 1.2 m; drop of any height (flat extra cost 1 when more than 1.2 m down); jet climb when the rise is at most the smaller of 45 m and 55% of max energy, costing distance + 25 + 4 per metre climbed, so roofs are routable but discouraged. A* is 8-connected with a straight-line heuristic and is resumable: it runs in slices of 0.5 to 5 ms per tick, sized to keep the whole tick under about 15 ms, and if the goal is unreachable it returns the path to the closest cell reached. Replan triggers: goal moved more than max(8 m, 15% of remaining distance), more than 10 m off the path, plan older than 5 s, or a stuck event. Following: advance to the nearest of the next 25 nodes, then steer at the farthest of the next 10 nodes reachable by a straight walk (three parallel probe lines 1.6 m apart). Climbs: if a rise appears within the next 3 nodes and 6 m, require energy of 1.6 x height + 6; if short, creep at 20% speed at the wall until recharged; then jump when grounded and hold the jet while airborne until 0.8 m above the lip. Within 10 m of a goal with a clear line it steers directly and slows down. Local steering fallback probes 3.2, 5 and 7 m ahead with 1.8 m side offsets, tries deflections of 0.35 to 1.75 rad on a remembered side first, and jets over the obstacle if nothing is clear, it is under 45 m and energy exceeds 15 + 1.4 x height. Stuck rule: wanting to move but displaced less than 1.5 m horizontally and 2 m vertically over at least 1.3 s with speed under 2.5 m/s triggers a 1.1 s escape (first half keeps pushing at the goal while jumping/jetting, second half heads 90 to 136 degrees off to a random side), flips the detour side and forces a replan. At hello it warms the JIT by running four long planner queries up to three times (4 s cap).",
 "aiming_and_fire_control": "Gun: closed-form constant-velocity intercept (quadratic), with 0.06 s of latency added to the target position, flight time capped at 2 s, shooter origin taken 3 m ahead along the current aim, target vertical speed ignored below 1.5 m/s and halved above; aim point is mid-height of a body scaled by cube count. It fires when its own map check shows a clear muzzle line, distance is under 97% of gun range, the linear aim error is under 0.9 x target radius + 0.5 m + 0.4% of distance, and the magazine is loaded. In free-for-all mode shots beyond 170 m are only taken at targets moving slower than 4 m/s. Reload: an early reload is ordered only in quiet time (no target, no crate being shot) when the magazine is below 60%; in a fight it shoots the magazine dry and walks to cover during the reload. Mortar: used first whenever off cooldown and the target is 25 to 220 m away; flat arc if the tube (top of the body) has a line to the target, otherwise the high arc for indirect fire over buildings; three iterations of leading by flight time + 0.1 s; fires when yaw error is under 0.03 rad and pitch error under 0.02 rad; the gun does not fire on ticks where the mortar solution owns the aim. Lightning: fires when the target is visible, inside 97% of range, within 45% of the cone angle of the current aim, and energy is above 8; ground boosting is suppressed below 30 energy during a fight to keep energy for it. Laser: starts charging when the target is visible, off cooldown and within 97% of range; aims straight at the body centre with a 0.1 s velocity nudge; at full charge it releases only when the target is visible and the aim error is under 0.8 x target radius, otherwise keeps holding (letting the auto-fire happen); while charging the laser line owns the aim and the gun fires only if its lead point lies within 0.8 radius of that line; no weapon swap while a charge is held; no ground boost while charging. When idle it sweeps the aim about 1 rad either side of the travel direction, or looks along the last threat bearing for 4 s.",
 "survival_and_anti_squad_tactics": "Practice-mode stance is aggressive, not evasive: the \"only fight who attacks me\" switch is off, so it engages every mech within 150 m (and farther ones that hit it within 6 s). There is no multi-hunter plan in the shipped defaults: the kite rule (stretch standoff to 100 m when two or more mechs within 120 m were seen in the last second) and the turn-to-face-unseen-attacker rule both exist but are switched off. Fight movement: radial term (distance minus desired range, over 25 m, clamped) plus a sideways strafe weighted 0.9, strafe side re-randomised every 0.8 to 2.2 s. Desired range: 28 m holding lightning with energy above 20; 40 m versus a drone; 80 m versus an enemy holding lightning; 90 m with laser; 80 m with mortar; 70 m gun only. Below 30% HP against a target with more HP it backs straight away while still facing it. Cover use (on): when the target is visible within 200 m and either the gun is empty or has more than 0.4 s of reload left with no secondary ready, or own HP is under 45% and the enemy has more than 1.2 x our HP, it walks to the nearest spot within 16 m (rings from 3 m, 16 directions) that is reachable in a straight walk, not above step height or more than 6 m below, and hidden from the enemy's eye at both mid-body and head height; ties go to the spot farther from the enemy; refreshed every 0.5 s; it stands still once within 1.5 m. A target that breaks line of sight is chased only if it is under 35% HP and we are above 50%. Healing: only when there is no fight target, HP under 60% and a threat bearing from the last 20 s; it finds cover against an imaginary viewer 70 m along that bearing, walks there at 42% speed (4.9 m/s, just under the 5 m/s footstep-sound threshold) and stands, sweeping its aim around the threat bearing. Dodging: a bullet whose closest approach within 0.9 s is inside body radius + 0.8 m triggers a 0.35 s perpendicular sidestep; a mortar shell predicted to land within splash radius + 3 m triggers 0.6 s of boosted running directly away; an enemy flagged as charging and aimed within about three body radii of us triggers a dash to the nearest line-of-sight-breaking spot reachable before the shot (reach = remaining charge time x 16 m/s if energy allows boosting, else 11 m/s, capped at 14 m), otherwise a 0.5 s sideways jink. Early game: roams at full speed between random points inside 55% of the next circle radius until 150 s to find drones, crates and cubes, then drops to the silent 42% speed. Late game: after 300 s it stops hunting drones and stops shooting crates while damaged so the regeneration timer is not reset. Free-for-all detection (switches policy permanently): two or more deaths not caused by us before 120 s, three before 200 s, six at any time, or an evidence counter reaching 3 (plus 1 per beam that ends within 4 m of a mech other than its shooter, plus 0.5 per observed HP drop above 40 on a mech we did not hit that tick). In that mode it fights only mechs that hit it in the last 6 s, are within 55 m, are under 40% HP within 150 m, or were already its target; otherwise it faces the nearest watched mech, creeps silently out of its sight and stands still, and it holds a sheltered spot (shelter = share of 8 directions with something solid within 16 m) near the closest point inside 60% of the next radius.",
 "loot_weapons_upgrades": "Weapon preference lightning > laser > mortar; the gun is always kept and the secondary is swapped only for a higher-ranked kind (take and drop issued in the same action). Ground weapons are remembered indefinitely and forgotten only when the spot is seen empty from within 40 m. Loot is chosen by smallest (distance minus bias): cubes bias 30 m, considered within 90 m when idle and 25 m during a fight; weapons bias plus 40 if we have no secondary, plus 40 more for lightning, plus 15 for laser; search radius with no secondary is 200 m before 200 s and 110 m after; with a secondary it is 120 m for a lightning upgrade and 60 m otherwise; 20 m during a fight. Loot more than 40 m above us, or more than 60 m outside the next circle after 40 s, is ignored. Each loot goal gets a time budget of 8 s + distance/7 and is blacklisted for 30 s when exceeded. No loot seeking while the zone is urgent. Supply drops: taken only when there is no loot goal and no mech target, within 250 m in practice (in free-for-all only within 120 m and only if no mech was seen for 8 s), only once the drop will land within our travel time + 3 s, and only if no other mech is holding it; it stands still within 3 m of the centre. Crates: when idle it shoots the nearest crate within 70 m with a clear line (gun, or lightning when in range with energy above 40) and walks toward it at 80% speed if beyond 25 m. Drones: hunted when there is no mech target, own HP above 40%, before 300 s, within 90 m with a clear line, at 40 m standoff; a drone that hit us in the last 3 s within 70 m takes priority over any mech target farther than 80 m. Practice upgrade order: armor, plating, gun rate, lightning efficiency, laser damage, gun damage, nanites, laser charge, lightning range, gun magazine, gun velocity, mortar reload, lightning chain, servos, reactor, capacitor, jets, gyros, mortar splash, mortar velocity, sensors, laser pierce. Free-for-all order moves plating first, armor second, nanites third and servos up.",
 "zone_and_endgame": "It interpolates the live circle between shrink start and end. Zone becomes the top priority when it is within 3 m of the live edge or outside, or when it is outside the next circle's inner margin (margin = 25% of next radius, clamped 4 to 40 m) and the time to shrink is less than travel time at 80% walk speed plus 12 s (30 s in free-for-all), or the shrink has begun. The destination is the point at 80% of (next radius minus margin) on the ray from the next centre toward us, so it enters by the shortest path and stays near the edge; it goes to the centre instead when the next radius is below 20 m or it is already outside the live circle; every goal is clamped at least 35% of the live radius (minimum 6 m) inside the live circle. It boosts (energy above 25) when outside or when behind schedule by more than 20 m. While strafing in a fight, from 15 s before a shrink it bends its movement inward if it would leave the next circle. Endgame: once the next radius is the final point, from 12 s before the last shrink it walks to the final centre (kept inside the moving circle), with 4 m tolerance before the shrink starts and 0.8 m after; it stands still there when it has no target and caps its speed at 50% when fighting.",
 "housebot_observations": "Nothing is recorded from the real scorer. The only evidence is the author's own emulator of the practice squad, which encodes their working model rather than measurements: tiers of 4/4/4/3; number of active hunters = 1 + house bots already dead, plus 1 after 150 s, plus 2 more after 220 s, and everyone after 300 s; hunters are drawn weakest tier first; the squad shares our last seen position; a non-hunter joins only if we damaged it in the last 8 s or it sees us within 45 m; house bots keep about 60 m (25 m with lightning), strafe, never retreat or heal, idle ones pick up one weapon within 120 m and wait inside the next circle while spinning their view. They test under two parameterisations because the real behaviour is uncertain: \"harsh\" (any bot we damage retaliates from any distance; aim noise standard deviation by tier 0.06/0.04/0.025/0.012 rad) and \"mild\" (retaliation only within 60 m; noise 0.08/0.05/0.03/0.015 rad); lead fraction by tier 0/0.5/0.8/1. After a false switch it becomes passive (hides, fights only within 55 m or when attacked), which should cost kills.",
